subject: Post-call recap: procurement path & trial conversion triggers
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement path & trial conversion triggers

Samir — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook: 

Call summary
- Use case: Nova Product Labs wants to embed an assistant in your admin console for internal ops (invoices, incident summaries).
- Expected QPS: light to medium (peak ~60 req/min); initial pilot scope ~10 engineers; growth to ~60 engineers in 90 days.
- Key non-functional: data isolation, audit logs, and predictable billing cadence for procurement.

Procurement path options you asked about
- Card (self-serve): immediate onboarding, billed monthly; good if procurement ops are minimal.
- PO / Invoice: standard for current enterprise vendors; requires PO number and P2P processing, usually ~7–12 business days for Nova Finance.
- Marketplace: if you prefer vendor consolidation via your procurement marketplace, we can list there — slightly longer onboarding and some contract templating needed.

Trial & conversion criteria (proposed)
- Trial length: up to 30 days, with a soft conversion trigger when either: (a) 1M tokens consumed, or (b) 14 calendar days after pilot activation — whichever comes first.
- Success signals: 80% of pilot engineers have created >5 successful calls/day; latencies below 350ms p50 for admin flows; no P1 security items in 14 days.
- Billing start: we recommend billing start aligned with the conversion trigger (token threshold or end of the 14-day active usage window), or a specified calendar start if Nova prefers a fixed date.

Next steps
1) Samir: confirm procurement preference (Card / PO / Marketplace) and expected PO processing SLA.
2) Marissa & Neha: prepare the SOW draft and a concise procurement pack (PO instructions + SOC2 excerpt) for Samir's finance team.
3) Connor: hold a short onboarding call to review pilot configuration once procurement path is decided.

Attachments included for initial review: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (stub), Procurement-instructions-PO.docx (stub), SOC2-excerpt.pdf (stub).

If this aligns with your read, reply with the procurement path and an estimated date for PO issuance (if applicable).

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior AM, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Procurement-instructions-PO.docx (DOCX)]
[Attachment: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (PDF)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@novaprod.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@averagetech.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path & trial conversion triggers

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers and a couple of clarifying questions from our side: 

Procurement & timeline
- Preference: PO / Invoice path. We standardize vendor spend on PO whenever the monthly spend is expected to exceed $10k.
- Timeline: Finance indicated ~10 business days once they receive a completed PO packet with vendor tax W9 and SOW.

Trial conversion preference
- We like the token threshold approach, but please confirm how you measure "1M tokens" (prompt + completion? raw tokens consumed on our API?). We want exactness for internal forecasting.
- If we reach the token threshold sooner than the 14-day minimum, what's the billing start logic? Is it immediate invoice, or do you provide a grace period?

Marketplace
- We are evaluating your listing on the CloudMarket we use; that might be our preferred long-term path but it will add ~2–3 weeks to vendor validation. Not our first choice for the initial pilot.

Action from us
- I will ask Finance for a point of contact and aim to provide a PO issuance target by next Wed (2026-12-01).

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Nova Product Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaprod.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path & trial conversion triggers

Samir — appreciated. Quick clarifications on how we handle the two token/billing scenarios so finance can reconcile expectations: 

How we measure token consumption
- Our billing meter counts both prompt + completion tokens seen by our API. We'll provide a sample export (CSV) that shows token breakdown by request id during the pilot.

Billing start & grace options
- Standard approach: billing is triggered the day a conversion condition is met (1M tokens or 14 active days). If token threshold is hit mid-day, we bill from that date forward.
- Flex option (if Nova requests): we can apply a 5-business-day grace window after threshold to allow for internal approvals; during grace we will continue the pilot without charging. This requires explicit agreement in the SOW.

SOW notes and PO packet
- Attached is the draft SOW with a short clause describing the billing trigger options and the grace window as a toggle.
- Also included is a simple PO checklist for Nova Finance (who to address invoices to, remittance info, Redwood tax IDs).

If you can confirm PO target date next Wed, we'll fast-track the PO packet with your finance contact and include the grace-window toggle in SOW for legal sign-off.

Best — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement path & trial conversion triggers

Samir — quick follow to lock dates and next steps: 

Planned timeline
- 2026-11-25: Redwood sends final SOW with optional grace clause (we will toggle on if you request).
- 2026-12-01: Target PO issuance date (per your note).
- Pilot activation: we can flip the pilot on the same day PO is processed, or earlier if you want to start on card and convert mid-trial.

Next meeting
- I'll schedule a 30-min finance + technical sync for Wed 2026-12-02 to walk through the PO packet and the token reporting CSV. Please indicate the best contact on your finance/ops side and Elena (cc) if she wants to coordinate marketplace timing.

Thanks again — we want to make the conversion step predictable for Nova. 

Connor O'Brien
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
